code.why: The World's process-exit door: a machine's process ending by itself (a worker that drained its queue), outside the Machines API. Substrate's workspace is paused and destroyed through the API, so only that door makes the move. https://docs.fly.io/machines/machine-states/
The coverage walk calls the pack fetch inside its World. The standalone HTTP host process is exercised separately by conform and cannot be reached through that fetch walk.

The World's machine pool around the fetch: a guest it runs exiting by itself, a run it cannot start (the launch failing), a run it does not admit; this story's World enrolls the fake pool, whose guests start when asked and run until stopped.
